mentions.description: A tiny terminal config, dotfiles, and tool installation manager that keeps setups in sync across machines, with profiles for tailoring each machine's configuration. Built as a hyper personal software project intended just for the author.
mentions.problem: Keeping terminal configs, dotfiles, and installed tools in sync between multiple machines.
mentions.audience: Personal use by the author only
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on a tiny terminal config / dotfiles / tool installation manager so I can keep everything in sync between my machines. Also includes profiles so I can tailor each machine how I see fit.
